failure_reasons.detail: repository configuration defines a program Git would run (filter.evil.clean from file:.git/config); refusing to inspect an untrusted repository (code: executable_git_config)

limitations: Post-execution detection only; does not prevent or sandbox any action.
New ignored files are compared with a baseline set; content changes to already-ignored files and changes outside the repository are not seen.
Without an operator-supplied baseline record, a contract that wrongly records a clean baseline cannot be disproved; the record itself is not authenticated.
Commands are never run, so exit codes are agent-reported; a sha256 pin or manifest shows byte-identity only and does not authenticate evidence or prove execution.

guidance: Owner-controlled recovery: this tool never resets, cleans, deletes, checks out or overwrites anything. Review `git status` and `git diff <baseline_sha>`, then decide to keep, revert or archive the work yourself, preserving any changes you want. Re-verify with a new contract afterwards.
